profit_quality.assessment: 经营现金流连续三年为正且资本开支低，但利润分母质量中等偏低：现金利息在剥离现金后不可持续，政府补助占利润比例高，2022 和 2024 含委托贷款减值转回，软件/系统集成业务还需要保留营运资金。主口径使用 HK$42m 折前可分配现金利润，并按 0.65 折为 HK$27.3m。
adjustments: 2024 reported parent net profit HK$47.856m is not used directly.

Treat HK$9.012m impairment reversal/deposit recovery as non-recurring.

Use three-year operating FCF check: 2024 HK$66.432m, 2023 HK$28.948m, 2022 HK$41.806m before removing cash interest; choose HK$42m pre-haircut rather than best year.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: OCF was HK$68.514m/31.379m/46.989m in 2024/2023/2022; capex was HK$2.082m/2.431m/5.183m. Cash generation supports a positive denominator, but not at reported-profit face value.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: 0.65 reflects positive but uneven cash conversion, policy/grant dependence, stripped cash interest, and project/customer working-capital needs.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Three-year FCF median is positive; 2023 was weak due to working-capital outflow, while 2024 benefited from receivable/inventory release and reduced payables.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: PPE purchases are low; no material capex commitments. Reported PPE purchases are used as maintenance capex proxy.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 90-day billing terms, contract assets, trade receivables and contract liabilities require a meaningful operating cash reserve.
